your_book:
Thursday's session was a mixed but broadly constructive day for Jaleel's book, though it did little to close the overall unrealized gap of −1.72%. The standout mover was RKLB (Rocket Lab), up +6.47% on the day — the headline about SpaceX's $2 trillion valuation appears to have lifted sentiment across the commercial space sector. The problem: RKLB is already down −13.5% since entry, carries an AVOID verdict, and a QARP score of just 38.4 — the weakest in the entire book by a wide margin. A single-session pop on sector enthusiasm is not a thesis. NVDA and AVGO added +2.54% and +2.29% respectively, both benefiting from broad chip-sector tailwinds tied to falling yields, lower oil, and Intel–SK Hynix manufacturing chatter. NVDA remains one of the two largest weights at ~10%, so that contribution mattered. LULU bounced +3.55% today, but that needs context: the position is still down −22.3% on an active guidance-cut risk flag, with the next catalyst not until December 9.

On the drag side, BSX slipped −0.82% and sits at −11.2% unrealized — a STRONG BUY rating that is being tested by real fundamental deterioration (FY26 growth guidance cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5%, flat guidance through Q3, next report October 28). Price and thesis are visibly diverging there. EFX fell −1.61% and is down −6.8% overall despite a STRONG BUY / QARP of 77.4 — a quiet drifter worth keeping an eye on. The software pocket was split: ADBE eked out +0.87% despite a sector-level headwind (Middle East tensions, rate-hike noise rotating traders out of growth), while SAP added +0.22% on favorable AI-narrative color.

The structural concern in the book remains the cluster of STRONG BUY names that are underwater: BSX at −11.2%, RKLB at −13.5%, ONON at −13.0%, NVS at −13.4%, LULU at −22.3%, and ZTS at −7.3%. The ratings say add; the P&L says the market disagrees. That divergence — not today's session — is the real thing to watch.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name up +6.47% today — still down −13.5%; no thesis support
attention.note: Today's pop is sector-driven noise (SpaceX valuation headlines), not a fundamental shift — RKLB carries the book's lowest QARP (38.4) and an AVOID verdict, and a capital-preservation mandate has no clean reason to hold this through further drawdown.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, down −11.2%, next print October 28
attention.note: A STRONG BUY rating is hard to defend when management has already guided flat through Q3 after cutting FY26 growth targets nearly in half — the October 28 earnings report is a binary event for whether the thesis is still intact.

attention.headline: +3.55% bounce today doesn't change −22.3% hole or the guidance-cut flag
attention.note: Americas comps have been negative for five straight periods, tariffs are pressuring margins, and China has stalled — today's move is a relief rally in a broken trend, with no fundamental catalyst until December 9.

attention.headline: Narrative risk, not numbers, continues to drive the stock
attention.note: ADBE held up today despite sector headwinds, but the CFO exit, ARR de-emphasis, and AI-moat fear (Claude Design) mean any software sector rotation or negative AI narrative headline could re-accelerate the disconnect between fundamentals and price before the December 8 print.
